hero.description: RunAiNi was born from a simple frustration: elite football intelligence was locked behind expensive, clunky enterprise software. We decided to change that.

mission.title: Democratize Elite Football Management
mission.paragraph1: Every player deserves data-driven development. Every coach deserves tools that match their expertise. Every academy deserves infrastructure that scales with their ambition.
mission.paragraph2: We built RunAiNi in public — committing to transparency, shipping features weekly, and listening to coaches on the ground. The result is a platform that feels designed by coaches, not for a market segment.

timeline.title: Where We Came From. Where We're Going.

items.desc: Admin, Coach, and Player spaces shipped. Core player management, event scheduling, and group notifications live.
6-Pillar Evaluation System, AI Position Predictor, and KPI Radar charts added. PDF export goes live.
Subgroup architecture, strict hierarchy filtering, and group-aware notification engine completely rebuilt.
Video analysis at scale, federation API, mobile app for players, and a public scouting network.

cta.title: Join the Movement
cta.description: We're building the future of football management in public, one feature at a time. Bring your academy along for the ride.

phases.d: Architecting the hybrid MERN-Django engine for high-concurrency academy data.
Developing the 6-Pillar scoring logic and predictive KPI radar mapping.
Connecting Admin, Coach, and Player spaces in a real-time responsive web ecosystem.

techEvolution.description: RunAiNi is built on a high-performance stack designed for infinite horizontal scaling and ultra-low latency data processing. Our architecture leverages the latest in frontend reactivity and backend robustness.
